title: Ansel and the Inventory
author: Freya Vane
blurb: Elodie Dravenmoor, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
